Thanks for the quick reply on our contact form. AtlasLedger would love a 30–40 minute walkthrough of Redwood Inference focused on latency/cost tradeoffs for batch scoring and an overview of Dedicated capacity. Our security reviewer (cc'd) may ask a few questions up front.

Heads up: my calendar UI (Gmail/GCal web) landed this in a thread as an .ics attachment only. The attached file doesn't surface the Zoom join details (our team cannot copy the passcode/dial-in from the .ics). Hi Elaine — Devin here (ops/hosting). Sorry for the confusion — this is a known quirk when an invite is generated by some calendar exporters and recipients view it inside Gmail; the .ics can appear as a downloadable attachment while the join URL lives in the event payload.

What I'll do now:
- Recreate the event directly from our Google Calendar as a Zoom meeting (so the join link is visible inline in GCal).
- Add AtlasLedger as a co-host for recording/host controls (we'll hand over co-host on the call).
- Attach a plain-text fallback with the Zoom URL and passcode in the email body so people can join if their client doesn't surface the event.

I'll send the new invite in the next 10 minutes; please accept when it arrives and let me know if anything else is blocked by your org SSO.
